Class for Direct Library Matching

Source: R/class_DirectLibMatch.R
DirectLibMatch-class.Rd

Represents a configuration for matching detected features against a compound library, using m/z and RT thresholds, ppm tolerance, MS level, and ion polarity.

Slots

FT

A data.frame of detected features (must include m/z and RT columns)

compounds_list

A list of known compounds with metadata

rt_thr_compound

Numeric loose RT threshold for precursor gate vs library RT (e.g. 30 s)

rt_thr_coelution

Numeric strict RT threshold for co-elution features to the matched precursor feature (e.g. 5 s).

ppm

Numeric parts-per-million tolerance for m/z

ms_level

Character, either "MS1" or "MS2"

polarity

Character, either "pos" or "neg"

results

List of matched results
